work_hours_per_week.description:
Full-time employees earning 50,000 MUR or under per month must work no more than 45 hours per week:
• If 5-day workweek: workdays cannot exceed 9 hours
• If 6-day workweek: workdays cannot exceed 8 hours for 5 days and 5 hours on the 6th day

Working hours are determined contractually for full-time employees earning over MUR 50,000 per month.

Part-time employees must work less than 45 hours per week.
